Engineering exercise 135: Reserved central collar does not imply one connected labyrinth.
Hollow an oriented-point reconstructed scan around a protected solid central collar. Discover all enclosed void components, identify each lowest sampled Z and cut 3 mm build-down drainage shafts. Explicitly review whether those shafts have damaged the collar or other load-entry material.
Use PicoGK 2.3.0, .NET 9, and an explicit headless 0.2 mm Library. Input contract: registered CSV x,y,z,nx,ny,nz,w,sx,sy,sz; outward normals; confidence (0,1]. Build direction is +Z; plate is z=0; default evacuation gravity is -Z unless the exercise specifies another removal pose. Nominal minimum wall is 1.0 mm, a coupon design assumption awaiting process calibration.
Provide a complete commented C# program with input and output arguments. Preserve review-only candidate.stl, report strict >45-degree underside failures, wall-ray samples, mesh edge incidence, material components, layer islands and powder-void connectivity. Do not label geometric screens as physical, leak-tight, fatigue or manufacturing qualification.
